---
title: "collapse_scores (binding only)"
output: html_document
date: "2026-03-11"
---

require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(png = list(type = "cairo")))

#list of packages to install/load
packages = c("yaml","data.table","tidyverse","gridExtra","egg")
#install any packages not already installed
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if(any(installed_packages == F)){
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}
#load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only=T))

#read in config file
config <- read_yaml("config.yaml")

#make output directory
if(!file.exists(config$final_variant_scores_dir)){
  dir.create(file.path(config$final_variant_scores_dir))
}

# binding data only (expression data no longer used)
dt <- data.table(read.csv(config$Titeseq_Kds_file),stringsAsFactors=F)

dt[is.na(log10Ka),TiteSeq_avgcount:=NA]

dt[,mean_bind:=mean(log10Ka,na.rm=T),by=c("library","variant_class","aa_substitutions")]
dt[,sd_bind:=sd(log10Ka,na.rm=T),by=c("library","variant_class","aa_substitutions")]
dt[,n_bc_bind:=sum(!is.na(log10Ka)),by=c("library","variant_class","aa_substitutions")]
dt[,avg_count_bind:=mean(TiteSeq_avgcount,na.rm=T),by=c("library","variant_class","aa_substitutions")]

dt <- unique(dt[,.(library,variant_class,aa_substitutions,n_aa_substitutions,mean_bind,sd_bind,n_bc_bind,avg_count_bind)])

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(dt[library=="pool1" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],main="pool1, bind",right=F,breaks=max(dt[library=="pool1" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],na.rm=T),xlab="number barcodes collapsed")
hist(dt[library=="pool2" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],main="pool2, bind",right=F,breaks=max(dt[library=="pool2" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],na.rm=T),xlab="number barcodes collapsed")

invisible(dev.print(pdf, paste(config$final_variant_scores_dir,"/histogram_n_bc_per_geno_sep-libs.pdf",sep=""),useDingbats=F))

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(dt[library=="pool1" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],
     dt[library=="pool1" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",sd_bind/sqrt(n_bc_bind)],
     pch=19,col="#00000005",main="pool1, bind",ylab="SEM",xlab="number barcodes collapsed")
plot(dt[library=="pool2" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",n_bc_bind],
     dt[library=="pool2" & variant_class=="1 nonsynonymous",sd_bind/sqrt(n_bc_bind)],
     pch=19,col="#00000005",main="pool2, bind",ylab="SEM",xlab="number barcodes collapsed")

invisible(dev.print(pdf, paste(config$final_variant_scores_dir,"/sem_v_n-bc.pdf",sep=""),useDingbats=F))

dt_mutant <- dt[variant_class %in% "1 nonsynonymous",]

#split mutation string
#define function to apply
split_mut <- function(x){
  split <- strsplit(x,split="")[[1]]
  return(list(split[1],as.numeric(paste(split[2:(length(split)-1)],collapse="")),split[length(split)]))
}
dt_mutant[,c("wildtype","position","mutant"):=split_mut(as.character(aa_substitutions)),by=aa_substitutions]

dt_mutant <- dt_mutant[,.(library,wildtype,position,mutant,mean_bind,sd_bind,n_bc_bind,avg_count_bind)]

aas <- c("A","C","D","E","F","G","H","I","K","L","M","N","P","Q","R","S","T","V","W","Y")
#fill out missing values in table with a hideous loop, so the table is complete for all mutations (including those that are missing). If you are somebody who is reading this code, I apologize.
for(lib in c("pool1","pool2")){
  {
    for(pos in 1:max(dt_mutant$position)){
      for(aa in aas){
        if(!(aa %in% as.character(dt_mutant[library==lib & position==pos,mutant]))){
          dt_mutant <- rbind(dt_mutant,list(lib, dt_mutant[library==lib & position==pos,wildtype][1],pos,aa),fill=T)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
setkey(dt_mutant,library,position,mutant)

#fill in wildtype values -- should vectorize in data table but being so stupid so just going to write for loop

for(lib in c("pool1","pool2")){
  dt_mutant[library==lib & wildtype==mutant, 
            c("mean_bind",
              "sd_bind",
              "n_bc_bind",
              "avg_count_bind"):=
              dt[library==lib & variant_class=="wildtype",.(mean_bind,sd_bind,
                                                            n_bc_bind,avg_count_bind)]]
}

#add delta bind measure
for(lib in c("pool1","pool2")){
  ref_bind <- dt[library==lib & variant_class=="wildtype",mean_bind]
  dt_mutant[library==lib,delta_bind := mean_bind - ref_bind]
}

par(mfrow=c(1,1))
x <- dt_mutant[library=="pool1" & wildtype!=mutant,mean_bind]; y <- dt_mutant[library=="pool2" & wildtype!=mutant,mean_bind]; plot(x,y,pch=19,col="#00000020",xlab="replicate 1",ylab="replicate 2",main="binding affinity");model <- lm(y~x);abline(model,lty=2,col="red");legend("topleft",legend=paste("R2: ",round(summary(model)$r.squared,3),sep=""),bty="n")

invisible(dev.print(pdf, paste(config$final_variant_scores_dir,"/replicate_correlations.pdf",sep=""),useDingbats=F))

dt_final <- copy(dt_mutant[library=="pool2"])

dt_final[ ,bind_tot:=mean(mean_bind,na.rm=T),by=c("position","mutant")]
dt_final[ ,delta_bind_tot:=mean(delta_bind,na.rm=T),by=c("position","mutant")]
dt_final[ ,n_bc_bind_tot:=sum(n_bc_bind,na.rm=T),by=c("position","mutant")]
dt_final[ ,n_libs_bind_tot:=sum(!is.na(mean_bind)),by=c("position","mutant")]

#switch to mature indexing of postitions
dt_final$position <- dt_final$position + config$site_number_offset

#add single mutation string
dt_final[,mutation:=paste(wildtype,position,mutant,sep=""),by=c("wildtype","position","mutant")]

dt_final <- unique(dt_final[,.(wildtype,position,mutant,mutation,bind_tot,delta_bind_tot,n_bc_bind_tot,n_libs_bind_tot)])

#add the rep2 bind average
dt_final[,bind_rep2 := dt_mutant[library=="pool2", mean_bind]]

#rename some of the columns
setnames(dt_final,"bind_tot","bind")
setnames(dt_final,"delta_bind_tot","delta_bind")
setnames(dt_final,"n_bc_bind_tot","n_bc_bind")
setnames(dt_final,"n_libs_bind_tot","n_libs_bind")

par(mfrow=c(1,1))
hist(dt_final[wildtype!=mutant, n_bc_bind],col="gray50",main=paste("mutant bind score,\nmedian ",median(dt_final[wildtype!=mutant, n_bc_bind],na.rm=T),sep=""),right=F,breaks=max(dt_final[wildtype!=mutant, n_bc_bind]),xlab="number barcodes")

#order mutant as a factor for grouping by rough biochemical grouping
dt_final$mutant <- factor(dt_final$mutant, levels=c("C","P","G","V","M","L","I","A","F","W","Y","T","S","N","Q","E","D","H","K","R"))
#add character vector indicating wildtype to use as plotting symbols for wt
dt_final[,wildtype_indicator := ""]
dt_final[as.character(mutant)==as.character(wildtype),wildtype_indicator := "x"]
dt_final[, normalized_delta_bind := ifelse(delta_bind > 0, 
                                            delta_bind / max(delta_bind, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                            ifelse(delta_bind < 0, 
                                                   -delta_bind / min(delta_bind, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                                   delta_bind))]

#make temp long-form data frame
temp <- data.table::melt(dt_final[, .(position,mutant,bind,delta_bind,wildtype_indicator)],id.vars=c("position","mutant","wildtype_indicator"),measure.vars=c("bind","delta_bind"),variable.name="measurement",value.name="value")

#for method to duplicate aa labels on right side of plot https://github.com/tidyverse/ggplot2/issues/3171
guide_axis_label_trans <- function(label_trans = identity, ...) {
  axis_guide <- guide_axis(...)
  axis_guide$label_trans <- rlang::as_function(label_trans)
  class(axis_guide) <- c("guide_axis_trans", class(axis_guide))
  axis_guide
}

guide_train.guide_axis_trans <- function(x, ...) {
  trained <- NextMethod()
  trained$key$.label <- x$label_trans(trained$key$.label)
  trained
}

p1 <- ggplot(temp[measurement=="delta_bind",],
             aes(position,mutant)
             ) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill=value),color="black",lwd=0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#A94E35","#A94E35","#F48365","#FFFFFF","#7378B9","#383C6C"),
                        limits=c(-5,2),
                        values=c(0/7,1/7,3/7,5/7,6/7,7/7),
                        na.value="yellow") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0),breaks=c(128,seq(130,310,by=5))) +
  labs(x="",y="") +
  theme_classic(base_size=9) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.6,face="bold",size=10),
          axis.text.y=element_text(face="bold",size=10)
          ) +
  guides(y.sec=guide_axis_label_trans()) +
  geom_text(aes(label=wildtype_indicator),size=2,color="gray10")

p1

temp <- data.table::melt(dt_final[, .(position,mutant,bind,normalized_delta_bind,wildtype_indicator)],id.vars=c("position","mutant","wildtype_indicator"),measure.vars=c("bind","normalized_delta_bind"),variable.name="measurement",value.name="value")

p2 <- ggplot(temp[measurement=="normalized_delta_bind",],
             aes(position,mutant)
             ) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill=value),color="black",lwd=0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#A94E35","#F48365","#FFFFFF","#7378B9","#383C6C"),
                        limits=c(-1,1),
                        na.value="yellow") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0),breaks=c(128,seq(130,310,by=5))) +
  labs(x="",y="") +
  theme_classic(base_size=9) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.6,face="bold",size=10),
          axis.text.y=element_text(face="bold",size=5)
          ) +
  guides(y.sec=guide_axis_label_trans()) +
  geom_text(aes(label=wildtype_indicator),size=2,color="gray10")

p2

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

temp_lollipop <- temp[measurement=="normalized_delta_bind" & wildtype_indicator=="",
                       .(mean_bind=mean(value, na.rm=TRUE)),
                       by=position]

nrow(temp_lollipop)
summary(temp_lollipop$mean_bind)

p_lollipop <- ggplot(temp_lollipop, aes(x=position, y=mean_bind)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="gray30", linetype="dashed", lwd=0.3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=position, xend=position, y=0, yend=mean_bind), 
               color="gray50", lwd=0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=mean_bind), shape=21, color="black", size=4, stroke=0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#A94E35","#F48365","#FFFFFF","#7378B9","#383C6C"),
                        limits=c(-1,1), na.value="yellow") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(add=1), breaks=c(128,seq(130,310,by=5))) +
  labs(x="residue position", y="mean\nnorm. delta bind") +
  theme_classic(base_size=9) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.6,face="bold",size=16),
        axis.ticks.x=element_line(),
        legend.position="none")

p_lollipop

write.csv(dt_final,"dtfinal.csv", row.names = FALSE)
